# Highlight Share

> Highlight Share is a Chrome extension for highlighting text on webpages, organizing highlights in a side panel, and sharing exact passages with W3C Text Fragment links.

Highlight Share turns a selected passage into a reusable reading note or a precise deep link. The recipient's browser can scroll to and highlight the quoted text without needing the extension installed.

## Product facts

- **Platform:** Chrome and modern Chromium-based browsers.
- **Core use:** select text on any webpage, apply a highlight color, organize highlights by page, and share the exact passage.
- **Deep links:** generates browser-native W3C Text Fragment URLs using `#:~:text=` anchors.
- **Organization:** side-panel browsing, multi-select, batch copy, numbered highlights, color palettes, and custom HEX colors.
- **Privacy:** highlights and preferences are stored locally in browser storage; no account or cloud database is required.
- **Distribution:** free Chrome Web Store extension and open-source project.

## Canonical answer

- **What is Highlight Share?** Highlight Share is a local-first browser extension that saves webpage highlights and creates links that take readers directly to the quoted sentence.
